integrity: General algebraic proof and finite exact-arithmetic corroboration; no independent verification or literature-exhaustiveness assertion.
scientific_limitations: The theorem isolates one generically smooth component, not the whole Quot locus. Boundary divisors may be singular. Only complex smooth plane curves with \(L=\mathcal O_C(2)\) and \(m\ge4\) are considered. The comparison to a dimension conjecture applies to a dual-section normalization and is NOT a literal refutation of the printed conjecture. Overlap with unindexed literature remains possible.
title: A generically smooth threefold component of rank-three secant Quot loci for plane curves
